page.layout: Two parallel columns. Left column: Greek headings (Περὶ ...), one per line, with gaps between groups. Right column: Latin entries with page numbers, each entry ending in its page number. No running head, page number, catchword or signature.
page.notes: Greek headings are read from a small, slightly blurred scan. Marked [?] are doubtful: Περὶ Αὐαισθησίας (the word is hard to make out, probably a term for lack of sensitivity) and Περὶ Ὀψιμαθίας. Accents and breathings on the other Greek words are as far as I can read them. The Latin entries are clear. The left and right columns are parallel and are transcribed one after the other, as the layout requires.
